title: Dhamu Rakaputsa Umambo
intro: Nyika ine nzizi dzinoyerera, minda miviri yakasvibira, uye kubudirira kusingaenzaniswi — asi vagari vayo vakarega kuteerera Iye akavaropafadza. Zviyeuchidzo pazvakauya zvichivadana kuti vadzoke, vakatendeuka. Chirango chakatevera chaive chichiri kurira senyevero. Ndiani aive nzanga yekare iyi?
clues: Taigara munyika yakakomborerwa zvekuti musha wedu waiva pakati peminda miviri yakasvibira.
Takanakidzwa nenzizi dzaiyerera dzichipfuura nemuminda yedu uye goho guru richizadza dzimba dzedu.
Asi patakadaidzwa kuti titende uye titeerere Ishe wedu, takatendeuka nekudada.
Pfuma yedu nekugara zvakanaka kwedu zvakatiita kuti tikanganwe Iye akapa zvese.
Ipapo kwakauya mvura zhinji yakangoerekana yapinda nemuchipingamupinyi chikuru chatakanga tavimba nacho.
Isu tiri vanhu veSaba', vane nyika yaizivikanwa neMa'rib Dam guru.

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
